purpose: Original millisecond timer initialization/update inputs for the main physical-frame producer.
limits: Finite nonnegative override/scale; finite signed fractional state. Truncation sum must fit signed64 before retaining its low32 word; nonrepresentable output rejects atomically in C++.
Pause entry/resume methods and main loop ownership/configuration remain separate; update receives the actual raw pause byte/state.
No Windows timing, INI parsing, gameplay/contact/restart acceptance.
